coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three tasks. The four required constant settings and the specified logarithmic inference-time metric are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100-80GB SXM4 or H100 GPUs instead of NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB. Omits 10 repeated measured runs per task and fixed random seeds; 10 discarded warm-up runs are not repetitions. Does not specify the same installation of prompting frameworks and BoT repository configuration. Measures raw latency rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds. Also introduces extra baselines, BoT variants, and metrics outside the target design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected overall increase in BoT inference time nor the task-specific logarithmic timing results, including BoT being faster than PAL on Game of 24.
